label: Topsoil clay content
aggregation: county mean of 0-30 cm depth-weighted clay
notes: High clay (Vertisols, 'black cotton' soils) = waterlogging/flood-prone plains.
native_resolution: 250 m (read at 1 km by nearest-neighbour decimation)

label: Topsoil sand content
native_resolution: 250 m (read at 1 km by nearest-neighbour decimation)

label: Topsoil organic carbon
native_resolution: 250 m (read at 1 km by nearest-neighbour decimation)

label: Topsoil pH (H2O)
native_resolution: 250 m (read at 1 km by nearest-neighbour decimation)

label: Dominant soil group (WRB)
aggregation: most frequent SoilGrids WRB most-probable class in county
native_resolution: 250 m (read at 1 km by nearest-neighbour decimation)

label: Vertisol share
aggregation: share of 1 km cells whose most probable WRB group is Vertisols
notes: Cracking clay soils, seasonally flooded; agriculturally productive but hard to work.
native_resolution: 250 m (read at 1 km by nearest-neighbour decimation)

label: Amphibian species richness
aggregation: county mean of 10 km richness cells
source: BiodiversityMapping.org (Jenkins, Pimm & Joppa 2013; IUCN + BirdLife range maps, 2017-2019 versions)

label: Bird species richness
aggregation: county mean of 10 km richness cells
notes: BirdLife range maps v7, excl. seabirds.
source: BiodiversityMapping.org (Jenkins, Pimm & Joppa 2013; IUCN + BirdLife range maps, 2017-2019 versions)

label: Mammal species richness
aggregation: county mean of 10 km richness cells
source: BiodiversityMapping.org (Jenkins, Pimm & Joppa 2013; IUCN + BirdLife range maps, 2017-2019 versions)

label: Threatened bird species
source: BiodiversityMapping.org (Jenkins, Pimm & Joppa 2013; IUCN + BirdLife range maps, 2017-2019 versions)

label: Threatened mammal species
source: BiodiversityMapping.org (Jenkins, Pimm & Joppa 2013; IUCN + BirdLife range maps, 2017-2019 versions)

label: Vertebrate species richness (amphibians+birds+mammals)
aggregation: sum of the three county means
notes: Reptiles not included (not in the downloadable package). Range-map richness = potential, not observed, species.
source: BiodiversityMapping.org (Jenkins, Pimm & Joppa 2013; IUCN + BirdLife range maps, 2017-2019 versions)

label: Mean elevation
source: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 via Microsoft Planetary Computer

label: Terrain ruggedness (elevation std)
source: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 via Microsoft Planetary Computer
aggregation: standard deviation of elevation within county
